text: 20 years ago, my best friend invited me to a concert. I didn’t know the bands, so on the way out the door, I decided to bring my camera. I figured that even if I didn’t like the music, I could make photos. The bands were incredible and in that moment I didn’t know what it meant to be a music photographer, but I wanted more. From a career I never dreamed of, the cover of Rolling stone to becoming a Nikon ambassador to the photographer for the Tonight Show — everything traced back that one night.

My first time watching a concert🤣
BINI in 🇸🇬

3.5 years ago I went to my first Brandi Carlile show. What I was experiencing was so amazing that I wanted to document it in photos. I’d never really taken concert photos before.

A year ago, I shot my first show- Brandi Carlile at Red Rocks. I wasn’t a photographer. I’d never even used this new camera. But they let me try.

This week, I started working full time for Brandi Carlile and next week I go on tour 📸 

It’s wild how I can trace it back to those little iPhone 12 pics from the front row
